observations.behavior: Adds documentation and a bounded in-memory buffer for lifecycle events; no implementation.
observations.code_quote: `debug_recorder.rs` keeps a bounded in-memory buffer of structured lifecycle events, recorded at the same points that emit metrics, and it never influences routing: poll dispatch, commit and failure; every request the batcher sends (`RequestSent`) and how it settled (`RequestResolved`, with the unfinished count of a partial ack, or `RequestFailed` with its cause); worker health and membership.
